purpose: Evaluate released RotLLM SFN on contact recordings, then test fixed encoder with a newly fitted contact-only four-class head
preprocessing: 1 second at measured 4000 Hz, per-axis DCT-II, pad to 24000, RMS normalization; XYZ predictions and hidden vectors averaged
scale_ambiguity: Official process_single_data normalizes RMS to 1; current __main__ calls multipy_data to divide a saved dataset by 100. No released runtime record resolves which scaling produced the weights. RMS0.01 is designated primary before inference, both scales are reported.
native_metrics: Report bearing-conditional grouped probabilities and full 15-head grouped-with-gear-error separately, including raw gear mass. No four-class ground truth used to change native weights.

new_head.kind: sklearn multinomial LogisticRegression on 128-d mean hidden features
new_head.selection: fixed before results; no held-out model selection

external: keep and bigNormal never train or select; bigNormal known normal but excluded from main four-class score, keep unknown
limitations: Only 8 main recordings from the same physical fault bearings; no independent new acquisition; no original public test used; no claim of full RotLLM LLM performance or original-task statistical retention
